query: Oracle database license and support revenue

output.content:
Oracle does not separately disclose revenue for the **Oracle Database** product line; Database licenses are included within the company’s broader cloud-license and on-premise-license revenue stream, while related support is included in cloud-services-and-license-support revenue. [[1]] 

For Oracle’s fiscal year ended May 31, 2025, **cloud services and license support revenue was $44.029 billion**, up 12% from $39.383 billion in FY2024 and representing 77% of total revenue. [[2]] 

FY2025 **cloud license and on-premise license revenue was $5.201 billion**, up 2% from $5.081 billion in FY2024; this category includes licenses for Oracle Database, Applications, Middleware, and Java. [[2]] [[1]] 

Thus, the closest reported aggregate for Oracle’s recurring support-related revenue is **$44.0 billion**, but it cannot be reliably narrowed to “database license and support” revenue from Oracle’s public disclosures. [[2]] [[1]]

sources.title: UNITED STATES SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE COMMISSION Washington, D.C. 20549
Oracle - Oracle Announces Fiscal 2025 Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Full Year Financial Results
